steps.description: On the filtered, quantile-normalized log2(TPM+1) matrix from T1S1, fit a limma linear model with design ~0 + condition and test the contrast lesional - control (orient the contrast so positive log2FC = higher in lesional; state the direction explicitly in the output header). Contrast direction stated explicitly (positive log2FC = higher in lesional)
Counts of significant genes at FDR<0.05 and at FDR<0.05 & |log2FC|>1 reported separately for up and down

steps.context: tpm.csv carries HGNC gene symbols in its first column, matching the symbol-space GMT collections staged for human. Psoriasis lesional skin has a strongly expected interferon, TNF/NF-kB, IL-17 and keratinocyte-proliferation program — enrichment output should be read against that expectation rather than treated as a discovery.
steps.question: Which biological processes and hallmark programs are coordinately shifted in psoriasis lesional versus control skin?
constraints: Use human gene sets only — the data is Homo sapiens skin; do not use the mouse or rat collections that are also staged
Use the ~12,000 tested genes as the enrichment background, not a genome-wide universe, since the delivered matrix is already a subset
Rank by the moderated t statistic, not by log2FC alone, so low-expression genes with large but noisy fold changes do not dominate the ranking
steps.description: Take the full ranked gene list from T1S2 (all tested genes ranked by limma moderated t statistic, signed so positive = up in lesional) and run GSEA-preranked against human MSigDB hallmark gene sets and human GO Biological Process gene sets — both are staged in the environment as human symbol GMTs, which matches the HGNC gene symbols in tpm.csv, so no ID conversion is needed. acceptance_criteria: GSEA-preranked results against human hallmark and human GO-BP sets, with NES, BH-adjusted p and leading-edge genes
Directional ORA results for the up and down FDR<0.05 gene sets reported separately
Gene set size filter (10-500 after universe intersection) and the use of the tested-gene universe as background both stated
Dot plot of top enriched sets produced

plan.title: Psoriasis lesional vs control DE from TPM (limma-trend)
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a 12,000-gene x 12-sample gene-level TPM matrix (tpm.csv) plus a 12x2 metadata table, 6 psoriasis lesional vs 6 control skin, unpaired, single batch. No raw counts and no Salmon quantification directories were delivered, so count-based negative-binomial methods (DESeq2, edgeR) are not applicable — they require integer counts and library-size offsets that TPM cannot supply, and feeding rounded TPM into them fabricates a dispersion model. The defensible route on a TPM matrix is log2(TPM+1) with a linear model and empirical-Bayes moderation (limma with trend=TRUE, robust=TRUE), which is the standard treatment for pre-normalized abundance on the log scale at n=6/group. TPM is already a within-sample composition, so a highly expressed lesional program (e.g. keratins, S100s, SERPINB) can compress other genes' TPM; quantile normalization across samples on the log scale plus an explicit compositional caveat is the mitigation available without counts.

Track 1 runs the primary contrast. T1S1 loads and QCs the matrix — value-range sanity (are columns ~1e6 sums?), per-sample library composition, detection filtering, log transform, sample-level clustering (PCA, correlation heatmap) to check that lesional and control separate and to flag outliers before testing. T1S2 fits the limma-trend model for lesional vs control and emits the full ranked table with BH FDR, a volcano and a heatmap of top genes, plus a positive-control check against canonical psoriasis markers (IL36G, S100A7/8/9, DEFB4A, KRT6A/16/17, SERPINB3/4, CXCL9-11, IL17-axis) since a lesional psoriasis contrast has a very well-characterized expected signature and its absence would indicate a labelling or processing problem. T1S3 runs a rank-based Wilcoxon sensitivity contrast so the reported hit set is not an artefact of one parametric model.

Track 2 interprets the ranked list: hallmark and GO-BP enrichment on the full limma t-statistic ranking (GSEA-preranked, which uses all genes and is robust to the cutoff choice) plus ORA on the FDR-significant set, against the staged human MSigDB hallmark and GO gene sets. It depends on T1S2 and is not on the critical path for the research question, which is answered by the DE table itself.
